Required_Approval_Statement: 485/51, 375/85/25 and SHA-256 lock approved; no source overwrite
Author_Comments: Verified and accepted the frozen 485-study corpus, 51-column structure, evidence-scope distribution, and SHA-256 integrity. The original register shall remain immutable.

Required_Approval_Statement: 45 fields (27 core/18 extended), v1.1 thresholds and v1.2 six-field guardrail changes reviewed and accepted.
Author_Comments: Reviewed and accepted all 45 methodological fields, including the 27 core and 18 extended fields, revised operational thresholds, and six v1.2 coding safeguards.

Required_Approval_Statement: v1.2 internal evidence states and reviewer-facing crosswalk (explicit no vs full-text non-reporting, inaccessible, ambiguity, N/A, NOT_ASSESSED) reviewed and approved; 12/12 author calibration record checked.
Author_Comments: Accepted the evidence-state definitions and reviewer-facing reporting crosswalk. The 12-case calibration was reviewed and accepted. Explicit negatives, assessed non-reporting, insufficient access, ambiguity, and non-applicability remain distinguishable.

Required_Approval_Statement: Claim-specific source hierarchy, exact quotes and locations, source hashes, code commits and negative-search log approved
Author_Comments: Accepted claim-specific source precedence and provenance requirements, including verifiable quotations, source locations, document hashes, applicable repository information, and negative-search logs.

Required_Approval_Statement: v1.2 leakage risk: primary-claim materiality, safeguards for LOW, secondary HIGH retained, no unsupported risk dichotomization.
Author_Comments: Accepted the leakage-risk classification criteria. LOW requires affirmative evidence of applicable safeguards, while verified HIGH-risk secondary experiments remain separately documented.

Required_Approval_Statement: v1.2 primary experiment selection preregistered before performance, mixed cases preserved and sensitivity analysis predefined.
Author_Comments: Accepted the predefined primary-experiment selection policy. Mixed experimental findings must remain traceable, with primary-versus-any-experiment sensitivity analysis.

Required_Approval_Statement: 40-case B3 pilot feasibility/strata/seed rules accepted; not conflated with independent Phase C sample.
Author_Comments: Accepted the proposed 40-study stratified pilot design and reproducible selection rules. The pilot is a coding-calibration exercise and does not replace Phase C independent reliability assessment.

Required_Approval_Statement: Paper_ID based immutable Phase A mapping, blank proposed outcomes, source assertions, search/adjudication/change logs approved
Author_Comments: Accepted the B2 evidence-extraction architecture, including immutable Phase A mapping, initially blank Phase B decisions, source assertions, adjudication records, and version-controlled change logs.

Required_Approval_Statement: Independent Phase C sample and per-field agreement planned; not claimed completed or inferred from 37/40 historical verification.
Author_Comments: Accepted the requirement for independent Phase C coding, appropriate sampling, per-field agreement assessment, and adjudication. Historical 37/40 verification shall not be represented as independent inter-reviewer reliability.

Required_Approval_Statement: No manuscript count changes before Phase B verification and Phase C; versioned amendments only
Author_Comments: Accepted the publication freeze and controlled amendment requirements. Frozen Phase A results shall not be replaced until evidence verification and independent reliability assessment justify revised manuscript findings.

Required_Approval_Statement: v1.2 documentary nonreporting (not actual nonuse), specific No subtypes, task-level N/A, scope and source-access guards approved; CAL10/11 clarifications accepted.
Author_Comments: Accepted the distinction between documentary non-reporting and confirmed methodological non-use, including separate negative-evidence subtypes, task-level non-applicability, source-access safeguards, and CAL10/CAL11 clarifications.
